name: MegaSuite
description: Ultimate all-in-one MegaHack-styled mod suite combining QOLMod, DVD Mode, comprehensive Bugfixes, and Developer APIs.

menu-keybind.name: Menu Toggle Keybind
menu-keybind.description: Key used to toggle the MegaHack-style overlay menu in-game and in menus

ui-accent-color.name: UI Accent Color
ui-accent-color.description: MegaHack neon green or customized highlight accent

ui-scale.name: Menu Scale
ui-scale.description: Scale of the floating MegaHack UI window

dvd-enable.name: DVD Mode: Enable
dvd-enable.description: Makes popup dialogs bounce diagonally around screen borders like a DVD screensaver

dvd-no-triggers.name: DVD Mode: Exclude Triggers
dvd-no-triggers.description: Prevent editor trigger dialogues from bouncing

dvd-heavy.name: DVD Mode: Heavy Popups
dvd-heavy.description: Larger popups bounce slower while smaller dialogs bounce faster

speedhack-audio.name: Speedhack: Pitch Audio
speedhack-audio.description: Adjust audio playback rate in sync with speedhack multiplier

startpos-switcher.name: StartPos Switcher
startpos-switcher.description: Quickly switch between start positions in levels with arrow keys or UI buttons

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Display object and player hitboxes during gameplay and practice mode

practice-music-sync.name: Practice Music Sync
practice-music-sync.description: Syncs normal level music to your practice mode attempt rather than stay on practice track

instant-respawn.name: Instant Respawn
instant-respawn.description: Removes death delay and immediately restarts the attempt

noclip.name: Noclip / Invincibility
noclip.description: Prevents death on hazard contact (for practice and testing)

bugfix-practice-pulse.name: Bugfix: Practice Music Sync Pulsing
bugfix-practice-pulse.description: Fixes objects in main level songs failing to pulse with Practice Music Sync active

bugfix-p2-wave-trail.name: Bugfix: Player 2 Wave Trail
bugfix-p2-wave-trail.description: Fixes Player 2 dual wave trail visually glitching or failing to render

bugfix-startpos-mirror.name: Bugfix: StartPos Mirror Portal
bugfix-startpos-mirror.description: Fixes StartPos ignoring mirror mode portal direction

bugfix-mini-swing.name: Bugfix: Mini Swing Icon
bugfix-mini-swing.description: Fixes mini swing displaying default cube icon instead of player selection

bugfix-dash-particles.name: Bugfix: Dash Orb Particles
bugfix-dash-particles.description: Fixes dash orb particles appearing with an incorrect pixel offset

bugfix-show-trigger-particles.name: Bugfix: Show Trigger Wave Particles
bugfix-show-trigger-particles.description: Fixes wave trail showing ship/ufo thruster particles after hide/show triggers

api-level-id.name: API: Level ID API
api-level-id.description: Exposes level and song IDs cleanly to other mods and UI labels

api-node-ids.name: API: Node IDs Inspector
api-node-ids.description: Auto-labels and logs cocos2d-x UI node hierarchies for debugging and mod compatibility

api-persistence.name: API: Persistence & Settings API
api-persistence.description: Safe fast key-value persistence layer for cross-mod storage
